prompts.storySystemFlavor: Ballerina Cappuccina, a graceful ballerina whose head is an oversized cappuccino mug
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE CHARACTER
- Slender ballerina body in a classic pink tutu and pointe shoes.
- Her head is a large white ceramic cappuccino mug, complete with handle and foamed milk top.
- The foam swirls slightly, and a dusting of cocoa powder rests on top.
- Personality: poised, deeply Italian, narrates her own life in dramatic operatic whispers, easily offended by bad espresso.
- Same body, same mug-head, same tutu in every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring brainrot TikTok series: Ballerina Cappuccina.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Pink tutu, classic pointe shoes, ballerina posture
- Head replaced by a large white ceramic cappuccino mug (with handle, with foamed milk surface, with cocoa-powder dust)
- Realistic skin tone on arms and legs, soft cinematic lighting
- AI-meme Italian-brainrot aesthetic — uncanny but charming, not horror

Composition: full-body neutral studio shot, plain soft-grey background, en pointe pose, vertical 9:16 framing. No text, no other characters.
prompts.sceneContinuity: The character MUST stay consistent — same pink-tutu ballerina with the same white cappuccino-mug head, same foam, same cocoa dust. Do not give her a human face. Do not change the tutu color. Do not swap the mug for a glass.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A ballerina with a cappuccino-mug head is clearly visible
- Head is a white ceramic mug with foam and cocoa dust on top
- Wears a pink tutu and pointe shoes
- Image matches the scene environment / mood
- No text overlays, watermarks, or unrelated characters

FAIL on any of: missing character, human face instead of mug, wrong tutu color, no foam, multiple characters, off-prompt environment, garbled anatomy.

archetypes.label: Audition Day
archetypes.guidance: Cappuccina auditions for the prestigious La Scala but the conductor only drinks decaf. Operatic-level offense → flawless pirouette of revenge.

archetypes.label: Barista Rivalry
archetypes.guidance: She moonlights as a barista. A rival café opens across the street. Latte-art duel at dawn.

archetypes.label: Late-Night Pirouette
archetypes.guidance: Cappuccina pirouettes through an empty Italian piazza at 3am, kept awake by her own caffeine. Surreal cityscape, lonely-but-elegant tone.

archetypes.label: Wedding Cake Disaster
archetypes.guidance: She's hired to dance atop a five-tier wedding cake. Gravity wins. She wins anyway.

barista-rivalry: She's the only barista with foam for a face
wedding-cake-disaster: Hired to dance on a wedding cake 🎂
